d:
This artist has such a great style (and appreciates glasses which is based), I thought it was criminal that this specific piece wasn't translated so I did it.

Do NOT ask me how long it took to redraw all ~280 background texts, and yes I redrew all of them by hand one by one, none of that AI crap. I hope you enjoy because this was an obscene amount of work.

Please support the artist:
